name: Hello Window

cmd: { echo 'Hello from a V2Mac mini VM.'; echo "Exit: $(cat /run/v2mac/exit.json 2>/dev/null)"; echo "Time zone: ${TZ:-unknown}"; echo 'Shared folder:'; ls ~/Shared 2>&1; echo; echo 'Type here; paste with Cmd-V:'; } > /tmp/hello.txt; exec zenity --text-info --editable --title='Hello Window' --width=900 --height=600 --filename=/tmp/hello.txt

securityNotes: Asks for the clipboard and the Shared folder to show both work.
